title: Record the one-role cap-two bill loss against the direct swap recipe.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped negative bill, not a construction and not a κ improvement. The one-role compilation of the #5083 five-call schedule has complete cap-two price `B = 2F` and outside difference `Delta = 0`. On the #5099 accounting screen `0 ≤ C ≤ 17/5000`, that bill misses the strict direct-recipe test

`B < (2F + 6Q - Delta)/4`

by more than `398/133` full-width calls. The selected conditional result stays `κ = 605457647/200000000000`.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04` (upstream CrocSwap `main`).

Task card: `bit-new-register-model`, scope **changed**. The card asks for a new register alphabet. [Discussion #1166 comment 19142691](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19142691) already moved the question to the physical cap-two price gate. This package prices that gate's one chronological compilation instead of opening another census.

Nearest work: #5083 (formal five-call word) and #5099 (`research/three-swap-cap2-physical-ceiling`, the direct-recipe threshold and the statement that no eligible caller was bound). This bill is the caller #5099 left open. It does not rerun either package.

The selected one-role contract is `notes/batched-bit-rows.tex` (each child uses `1/W` of the parent volume; repetitions are separate calls) together with `notes/three-stage-cover-bit.tex` (`J_A` costs at most three reversed children). Two owners therefore cost two width-`f` calls.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/cap2-one-role-direct-bill/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/cap2-one-role-direct-bill
```

Both passed here. The checker authenticates the pinned source bytes, requires the one-role and direct-recipe sentences, checks `399^5000 < 2^4983 * 200^5000`, rejects the break-even case `Q = F`, sweeps 128 widths at `C = 0`, accepts a below-threshold control `B = F` that is outside the one-role service, and records that a large negative `Delta` could change the decision. No native program, compiler, Lean build, or selected cold replay was run.

## Credit

Nick Petalas supplied the #5083 formal word. Chris R / Clear1nsight supplied the #5099 ceiling and two-owner volume reading. The BIT notes retain their source authors. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can a changed multi-owner primitive, not two one-role reversed calls, meet the strict inequality with the same volume, orientation, spectators and a fully charged outside bill? The selected one-role service does not supply `B < 2F`.
2. If a bill passes, does that inventory improve the selected #5413 complex moment after finite work, both tails, compiler reserve and outer transfer? Blocked until a passing bill exists.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The machine-readable open handoffs in #1166 are the structured `HANDOFF` blocks in comment order. Pricing the named next bill was enough; a second census of every BIT call site was not required once the one-role compilation already failed the gate.
